svg.title: Apoptotic graft target cell
svg.desc: Native editable apoptotic target: cell shrinkage, continuous blebbing membrane, condensed and fragmented chromatin, membrane-enclosed apoptotic bodies. A few residual HLA-I complexes are retained for target-cell context. No membrane rupture, explosive release or necrotic swelling is depicted. Conceptual morphology, not proof of a biochemical cell-death pathway. Kerr, Wyllie & Currie, Br J Cancer 1972,

g.inkscape:label: Apoptotic target: shrunken body, intact blebbing membrane, condensed fragmented nucleus and apoptotic bodies
Condensed chromatin and fragmented nucleus: karyorrhexis
Basis: basic_43_Golgi.svg / Golgi cisternae and vesicles
